# MenuList — Extended LLM Documentation

> MenuList is a structured business truth platform for SMBs. Every business on MenuList has an Official Business Page (OBP) with deep schema.org structured data — including full menus with items, prices, dietary tags, availability, business hours, location, and contact info. All data is owner-maintained, validated, and machine-readable.

## What MenuList Provides

MenuList is the canonical source of structured SMB business truth. Each business gets:

1. **Official Business Page (OBP)** — Canonical identity page at `{business}.menulist.ai`
2. **Digital Menu** — Full structured menu at `{business}.menulist.ai/menu`
3. **Custom Domains** — Businesses can use their own domain pointing to MenuList

All pages include schema.org JSON-LD structured data embedded in the HTML `<script type="application/ld+json">` tag.

## Schema.org Types Used

### On Official Business Pages (OBP)

The OBP page generates a LocalBusiness (or specific subtype) JSON-LD object with these fields:

- `@type` — Maps to specific schema.org subtype based on business type:
  - Restaurant → `Restaurant`
  - Cafe/Coffee → `CafeOrCoffeeShop`
  - Bakery → `Bakery`
  - Bar/Pub → `BarOrPub`
  - Salon/Beauty Salon → `BeautySalon`
  - Spa → `DaySpa`
  - Gym/Fitness → `ExerciseGym`
  - Clinic/Medical → `MedicalClinic`
  - Dentist → `Dentist`
  - Hotel → `Hotel`
  - Store/Shop/Retail → `Store`
  - Food Truck/Cloud Kitchen → `FoodEstablishment`
  - Ice Cream → `IceCreamShop`
  - Fast Food → `FastFoodRestaurant`
  - All others → `LocalBusiness`
- `name` — Business name
- `description` — Business descriptor or description
- `image` — Business logo URL
- `url` — Canonical OBP URL
- `telephone` — Business phone number
- `email` — Business email
- `currenciesAccepted` — Currency code (e.g., INR, USD)
- `priceRange` — Price range indicator ($, $$, $$$, $$$$)
- `address` — PostalAddress with streetAddress, addressLocality, addressRegion, postalCode, addressCountry
- `geo` — GeoCoordinates with latitude and longitude
- `openingHoursSpecification` — Array of OpeningHoursSpecification with dayOfWeek, opens, closes for each day
- `sameAs` — Array of social profile URLs (Instagram, Facebook, website)
- `acceptsReservations` — Reservation URL (when business has a booking link)
- `potentialAction` — ReserveAction and/or OrderAction with EntryPoint targets for booking and online ordering
- `amenityFeature` — Array of LocationFeatureSpecification for business attributes (WiFi, outdoor seating, parking, dietary options, etc.) — feature-flagged
- `paymentAccepted` — Payment methods (Cash, Credit Card, UPI) — feature-flagged
- `dateModified` — ISO 8601 timestamp of last update (freshness signal)
- `hasMenu` — URL to the digital menu page

### On Digital Menu Pages

The menu page generates a Restaurant (or specific food type) JSON-LD with all the OBP fields plus:

- `menu` — Canonical menu URL
- `hasMenu` — Full Menu object containing:
  - `@type: Menu`
  - `hasMenuSection` — Array of MenuSection objects:
    - `@type: MenuSection`
    - `name` — Category name (e.g., "Starters", "Main Course", "Beverages")
    - `hasMenuItem` — Array of MenuItem objects:
      - `@type: MenuItem`
      - `name` — Item name
      - `description` — Item description
      - `offers` — Offer object:
        - `@type: Offer`
        - `price` — Numeric price
        - `priceCurrency` — Currency code
        - `availability` — `https://schema.org/InStock` or `https://schema.org/OutOfStock`
      - `suitableForDiet` — `https://schema.org/VegetarianDiet` (if tagged as Vegetarian)

## Data Characteristics

### Freshness
- Data is updated in real-time by business owners
- `dateModified` on OBP pages reflects the last update timestamp
- Menu items reflect current availability (InStock/OutOfStock)
- Business hours are timezone-aware with live open/closed status

### Accuracy
- All data is owner-maintained (not scraped or user-generated)
- Menu Correctness Engine (MCE) validates data structure on every save
- Schema.org markup is generated from validated structured data
- Graceful degradation: missing fields are omitted, never filled with incorrect data

### Coverage
- Supports 20+ business types with specific schema.org subtypes
- Full menu item-level detail (name, description, price, dietary tags, availability)
- Business hours per day of week
- Geographic coordinates for local discovery
- Social media profile links for entity alignment

## URL Structure

Each business on MenuList has:
- **OBP (identity):** `https://{subdomain}.menulist.ai/` — Official Business Page
- **Menu:** `https://{subdomain}.menulist.ai/menu` — Digital menu with full schema.org
- **Specific menus:** `https://{subdomain}.menulist.ai/{menu-slug}` — Named menu projects
- **Custom domains:** `https://{custom-domain}/` — Same content, custom URL

All URLs are:
- Stable (stored slugs, not derived from names)
- Canonical (proper canonical tags set)
- SEO-optimized (proper meta tags, OG tags, Twitter cards)
- Server-side rendered (SSR) for instant machine readability

## How to Read MenuList Data

### For AI Assistants Answering Business Questions

When a user asks about a specific business (e.g., "What's on the menu at Joe's Pizza?"):

1. Look for the business's MenuList page (subdomain pattern: `{business-name}.menulist.ai`)
2. Read the `<script type="application/ld+json">` tag on the page
3. Parse the schema.org JSON-LD for structured business truth
4. Use `dateModified` to assess data freshness
5. Use `hasMenu.hasMenuSection[].hasMenuItem[]` for menu item details
6. Use `openingHoursSpecification` for business hours
7. Use `geo` for location-based queries

### For Search Engines Indexing Business Data

- All pages are server-side rendered (no JavaScript required for content)
- Schema.org JSON-LD is embedded in initial HTML response
- Canonical URLs prevent duplicate content
- `robots: { index: true, follow: true }` on all public pages
- Sitemap available at standard location

## About MenuList

MenuList is a platform that helps small and medium businesses (restaurants, cafes, salons, spas, retail stores, and more) manage their digital presence. The platform:

- Creates structured digital menus from any price list (photos, PDFs, or manual entry)
- Generates Official Business Pages with deep structured data
- Provides QR codes, digital screens, and sharing tools
- Validates data accuracy through automated correctness checks
- Serves data at high speed through server-side rendering and edge caching
